author: bd-spin/bd-spin-20260511T170438Z-856615
text:
Resolved by JMAP-06zp.1. The bead description has stale premises:

1. There is no "Session" struct in jmap-server. Session lives in jmap-base-client (crate-jmap-base-client/src/request.rs:102).
2. Session.capabilities is HashMap<String, serde_json::Value> — extension crates do NOT register typed structs there. They provide JMAP_*_URI constants + their own Capability struct in the extension-types crate, and consumers do session.capabilities.get(URI).and_then(deserialize) at the call site. This is the established workspace pattern — e.g. FileNodeCapability + JMAP_FILENODE_URI live entirely in jmap-filenode-types; jmap-base-client has no knowledge of them. The only typed Session accessor is websocket_capability(), and only because WebSocket is RFC 8887 base infrastructure that jmap-base-client itself uses for transport.
3. The URI constant (JMAP_METADATA_URI = "urn:ietf:params:jmap:metadata") and the typed MetadataCapability struct both shipped in JMAP-06zp.1 (commit 22c81a3) — see crate-jmap-metadata-types/src/capability.rs.

Adding a metadata_capability() accessor to Session would require jmap-base-client to depend on jmap-metadata-types, which is the wrong direction for a canonical foundation client crate and would create an unwanted cross-extension dependency. The canonical-template propagation rule explicitly warns against that.

No code change needed. Closing as done.
